properties.description: Two cargo aliases for working ON reflow2, and nothing that changes what a build produces. `cargo dev-test` = `cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --no-fail-fast`: the everyday command, both crates without RocksDB on the in-memory backend, skipping only the MCP crate's on_disk test program. `cargo full-test` = `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast`: CI's full job, with RocksDB, every program. Machine settings (jobs, debug info) stay in each person's ~/.cargo/config.toml.
properties.name: .cargo/config.toml — `cargo dev-test` and `cargo full-test`
